descriptions.zh: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!要求我们制止正在§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!发生的错误行为。我们需要对他们开战，强迫他们结束种群消灭的行径。
descriptions.en: The §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! have asked us to stop the ongoing atrocities in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. We will need to make war on them and force them to end their genocidal practices.

titles.zh: 任务：阻止人工智能研究

descriptions.zh: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!要求我们制止§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!开发智慧型人工智能的尝试。我们需要对他们开战，强迫他们禁止任何对人工智能的进一步开发。
descriptions.en: The §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! have asked us to stop the attempts by §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! to develop sapient AI. We will need to make war on them and force them to ban all further AI research.

descriptions.zh: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!要求我们对§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!宣战，而并没有很好地解释其理由。
descriptions.en: The §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! have asked us to declare war on §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! for reasons that are... not very well explained.

descriptions.zh: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!要求我们在§H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!上殖民。我们必须在那里设置一个殖民点并至少拥有§Y500§!£pop£§H人口§!。
descriptions.en: The §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! have asked us to establish a presence on §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. We need to establish a colony there and grow the population to be at least §Y500§! £pop£ §HPops§!.

descriptions.zh: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!要求我们在§Y20§!年里不要宣战或是加入任何进攻宣战。违反这一要求很可能会遭致报复。
descriptions.en: The §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! have demanded that we refrain from declaring or joining in any offensive wars for a period of §Y20§! years. Failing to obey this demand will likely bring retribution.

descriptions.zh: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!要求我们在§Y10§!年内不要殖民任何新的星球。违反这一要求很可能会遭致报复。
descriptions.en: The §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! have demanded that we refrain from colonizing any new planets for a period of §Y10§! years. Failing to obey this demand will likely bring retribution.
